objective: Update HolyAgent's docs on a 0.3.0 release branch so they describe the decided pi integration plan, without implementing it.
requirements: Maintainer (verbatim): "alright please update the docs in a 0.3.0 release branch" and "ask me questions for all open stuff and whatever else is needed"; earlier: "you aren't supposed to implement 0.3.0"; later: "also I want holyagent pi to be compatible with t3 code"; "t3code shall be the primary interface for the pi integration..."; "for 0.3.0, we will support both local and global installations for holyagent in claude and pi"; "also document that holyagent in claude chat/cowork (they're now unified) works correctly".

The docs record the plan as decided in the 0.3.0 pi Intents (decisions in /home/user/holyagent-work/pi-decisions.md, Intents in /home/user/holyagent-work/pi-intents-final.jsonl, now twelve with the T3 Code and install-scope Intents) and the sourced research facts; they describe it as the plan for 0.3.0, not as shipped behavior, and change no code.

Release model (repository convention): release/0.3.0/integration from main; the first PR (merged as #70) carried the bump made with mise run bump:minor; the T3 Code, install-scope and chat/Cowork docs follow on release/0.3.0/docs/t3-and-install-scopes into release/0.3.0/integration.
Do not change .claude/CLAUDE.md; keep the README's six fixed sections; detail goes in docs/.
Done means mise run verify passes with the build in sync and CI green including Windows.

Default (maintainer's standing instruction, "merge whenever merge ready"): the root squash-merges each reviewed, green docs PR into release/0.3.0/integration; the integration to main PR waits until the maintainer's 0.3.0 implementation lands, since main publishes a stable release.
